主要内容: On January 21, 2015, Kentucky Bancshares Inc (/KY/) entered into a share exchange agreement with Madison Financial Corporation. Under the terms, Kentucky Bancshares will acquire all of Madison's outstanding common stock through a statutory exchange. Following the transaction, Madison will merge with Kentucky Bancshares, and Madison Bank will merge with Kentucky Bank. Each share of Madison common stock will be exchanged for 1.1927 shares of Kentucky Bancshares common stock, plus cash for fractional shares. The exchange ratio may be adjusted if Madison's consolidated net book value is below $10,981,000 ten business days before the effective time. The transaction is subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals, and the effectiveness of the registration statement with the SEC. The parties expect to complete the transaction in Q2 or Q3 of 2015. The Company disclosed risks related to the transaction, including potential failure to obtain approvals, market, economic, operational, liquidity, credit, and interest rate risks. Regulatory changes, including the Dodd-Frank Act, could impact the transaction and business operations. These risks are detailed in the Company's SEC filings. The forward-looking statements are as of January 27, 2015, and the Company does not undertake any obligation to update them.
